description: Helps you decide what to send, and when, to open or restart a conversation. You give the persona, stage and objective (prospecting, nurture, follow up or re engagement), plus your solution, the pain point, value proposition, proof and ask. You get each email with its subject, send day and body, and a note on what you did not give. No placeholder is left in a body, and no result or statistic is invented. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of sales_enablement_content when you need scheduled outreach emails with subjects and send days.

call_to_action.description: Desired action (meeting, demo, reply). Format is text. For example, "book a discovery call".

key_value_prop.description: Primary value proposition. Format is text. For example, "resolve invoice exceptions before month-end".

num_emails.description: Accepted but not used yet: each sequence type has a fixed number of emails. Format is a JSON number. For example, 12.

sender_context.description: Context about sender (role, shared connections, etc.). Format is text. For example, "account owner following up after discovery".

sequence_type.description: Type of email sequence. cold_outreach, warm_follow_up, post_demo and re_engagement have their own templates; the other types return a general outline. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "cold_outreach".

social_proof.description: Customer names, stats, or proof points. Format is text. For example, "Company-reported pilot reduced approval time from 12 to 9 days in October 2026.".

specific_pain_point.description: Specific pain point to address. Format is text. For example, "invoice exceptions delay month-end close".

target_industry.description: Target industry for context. Format is text. For example, "manufacturing".

target_persona.description: Target persona (e.g., VP Sales, CTO, CFO). Format is text.

tone.description: Email tone. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "professional".

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "logistics_tech".

your_solution.description: Your product/solution. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

name: email_sequence_generator
title: Email Sequence Generator
